title: a settings file with only the three older JITSO groups is a warning that names the missing slot, not a failure
source: intended: docs/decisions.md A5 (defect N-25) and the doctor spec (defect N-20)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-25, owner answer A5). A settings file written before the write boundary registers the guard on PreToolUse Bash, PreToolUse orca MCP and SessionEnd. doctor prints `warn hooks: registered on PreToolUse Bash, PreToolUse orca MCP, SessionEnd only (missing PreToolUse file writes): run jitso setup hook` and exits 0, so a pipeline that runs doctor does not break.

stdout.regex: (?m)^warn hooks: registered on PreToolUse Bash, PreToolUse orca MCP, SessionEnd only \(missing PreToolUse file writes\): run jitso setup hook
